active_challenger.review_date: Sample-gated review; no automatic calendar promotion
active_challenger.primary_metric: Paired complete-session underlying return; descriptive until an effect hurdle is separately approved
active_challenger.minimum_effect: UNSET; no promotion permitted before a separate frozen effect hurdle is approved

candidates.hypothesis: Tiny initial risk in fresh trigger entries distorts R-based summaries.
candidates.rule_delta: Compare one preregistered alternative: minimum risk of 0.1 daily ATR OR an explicitly defined 34 EMA stop, using a new strategy version. Choose before evaluation.

candidates.hypothesis: Late/gap trigger performance may reflect a post-hoc cohort selection.
candidates.rule_delta: Test whether a separately named gap-and-go policy adds prospective session-level value compared with retaining all baseline trigger events.

candidates.hypothesis: Extended-session 13/48 EMA conviction may improve parity with the source indicator.
candidates.rule_delta: Create a separately versioned ETH-13/48 variant with a defined extended-hours warm-up and otherwise frozen rules.

candidates.hypothesis: Post-hoc reward/risk bucket boundaries may miscalibrate target forecasts.
candidates.rule_delta: Compare one frozen target-specific regularized log(R) model against a declared descriptive/baseline model on untouched chronological data.

candidates.hypothesis: Longer high-quality history may improve evaluation coverage and source stability.
candidates.rule_delta: Audit a candidate historical feed for timestamp, session, adjustment and bar parity before retraining any statistics.

candidates.hypothesis: Freezing the baseline can establish a clean prospective observation record.
candidates.rule_delta: Keep saty-sig-2.0 unchanged; first conduct a 20-session observation audit, then register GG and stress-grid experiments on future data.

candidates.hypothesis: EOD-01 EOD context may improve a preregistered prospective comparison.
candidates.rule_delta: On 1m completed bars, compare the latest two strict 2-left/2-right price pivots with the EMA21/ATR14 smoothed phase proxy at each pivot. Higher high/lower phase is bearish; lower low/higher phase bullish. Pivot known only when the second right bar closes; most recent pivot within 12 bars.

candidates.hypothesis: EOD-02 EOD context may improve a preregistered prospective comparison.
candidates.rule_delta: The same confirmed-pivot/phase divergence rule on 3m completed bars, recorded separately from EOD-01.

candidates.hypothesis: EOD-03 EOD context may improve a preregistered prospective comparison.
candidates.rule_delta: On each timeframe, the last 8-bar high-low range below 0.18 of previous-completed-day ATR is compression context. Confirmed 2-left/2-right swing levels in last 60 bars define demand/supply; a touch within 0.15 intraday ATR and close back away marks reversal context.

candidates.hypothesis: EOD-04 EOD context may improve a preregistered prospective comparison.
candidates.rule_delta: Prospectively record manually supplied top-ten 0DTE contracts by volume, premium versus contract VWAP, ITM classification, and a manual shakeout hypothesis. No spot-volume proxy or live weight change.

candidates.hypothesis: EOD-05 EOD context may improve a preregistered prospective comparison.
candidates.rule_delta: Prospectively record manual max-pain spot/range in the final 10 minutes and largest negative gamma node with ticker, units, expiry and source timestamp. Compare later attraction/rejection; no inferred options data.

candidates.hypothesis: Exiting at the first ATR target may improve win rate and reduce drawdown versus runner extension.
candidates.rule_delta: Same approved score60 entries, cap, cooldown and stops; runner disabled.

candidates.hypothesis: Exiting at the first ATR target may improve win rate and reduce drawdown versus runner extension.
candidates.rule_delta: Same soft-cap score60 entries, stops, cooldown and 15:00 cutoff; runner disabled. Fourth requires signal-bar radar >=55 and positive realized ticker session return.

rules: Run one frozen challenger against the unchanged baseline on the same eligible sessions, including zero-signal sessions.
Register the rule difference, primary metric, minimum useful effect, costs, exclusions and fixed review date before collecting evaluation data.
Collect at least 30 new market sessions and 100 nonduplicated eligible episodes; these are review floors, not proof of an edge.
Meet the registered effect and guardrail criteria with session-cluster uncertainty, source parity and delay/cost stress checks.
Require Carter's reviewed, versioned promotion PR, an effective date and a rollback commit. Never auto-promote or retune from a daily result.
